bytecode.description: What a deploy does with the V8 compile cache it warms for each node function.

cache.description: Warm a V8 compile cache for each node function at deploy, so cold starts compile less. Left off, false.

embed.description: Bundle each function's compile cache into its code package instead of fetching it from S3. Needs cache.

bytecode.title: BytecodeOptions

certificates.description: ARNs of issued ACM certificates, keyed by hostname. A hostname left off gets a certificate ocel manages.

logs.description: How ocel logs --tail reads this account's logs.

liveTail.description: Tail logs through CloudWatch Live Tail instead of polling. Billed per session-minute past the free tier.

logs.title: LogOptions

region.description: The AWS region to deploy into, such as us-east-1. Left off, read from AWS_REGION, AWS_DEFAULT_REGION or the profile.

variablesKey.description: ARN of a KMS key to encrypt this account's variables with. Left off, ocel creates one.
